purpose: Teach: 森下/片岡/水谷/丹羽/高岡/今村/津田/岡村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の森下部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Morishita.
lines.style: Clear, official. Brief pause after the opening—establishing authority without harshness. Steady pace, measured delivery. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の片岡課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the sales manager Kataoka's business trip schedule.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, no wasted words. Efficient and immediate—he's already mentally organizing the logistics. Slight nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の水谷主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: And assign the technology project to our lead technical officer, Mizutani.
lines.style: Direct instruction, same weight as before. The cadence of delegation—he's moving down a list with precision. No inflection seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の丹羽様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt the PR strategy that Niwa has developed.
lines.style: Brief, clipped response. Seamless transition—he's documenting mentally as he speaks. Efficient without rushing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の高岡様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with our advisor, Takaoka, for his guidance.
lines.style: Same steady pace, same authoritative tone. A slight lift at the end—this is a request for external input, not purely internal direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の今村様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare the financial closing schedule with our accounting manager Imamura.
lines.style: Professional affirmation. He's moving methodically through the checklist. No hesitation, no emphasis—just reliable execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の津田様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have our HR manager, Tsuda, oversee the new employee orientation program.
lines.style: Steady, confident instruction. The final item—slight finality in the delivery without sounding abrupt. Same deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の岡村様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that our legal team, Okamura, review the contract terms.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment, slightly more complete than the previous responses. Closing statement—a touch of settling into the tasks ahead. Clear, unhurried.
